lines.en: That shamelessly smiling face. She wanted to hurl vicious words at him. To say she would kill him if he ever did this again.
She had meant to do it, as she always did.
“Han Sooyoung.”
But she couldn't.
When she lowered her head, she saw Kim Dokja's ankles. The combat suit Mass Production Maker had made for him was in tatters.
Having become an Outer God King and fought the constellations, Kim Dokja was so covered in wounds that it would have been no surprise if he collapsed on the spot.
“······Are you okay?”
Even now, he was worried about her. Looking at him, Han Sooyoung did not know what to do with the feeling.
[The constellation, ‘Father of the Rich Night,’ looks at you.]
[The constellation, ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring,’ is satisfied with your answer.]
[The constellation, ‘Maritime War God,’ nods.]

The gazes of stars shining in the sky. Even amid the flood of indirect messages, Han Sooyoung still felt a chill down her spine. The image of the channel, blacked out only moments earlier, was still vivid in her mind.
「If she had made even the slightest mistake」
The constellations might not have helped. Probability might not have flowed as she expected. Her companions might not have held out.
What she had borne until moments ago was not a manuscript she could revise.
The burden of knowing that a single wrong step would bring down everything they had built.
Kim Dokja had always gone through the scenarios feeling like this.
[Your brain is in a state of severe overload!]
Kim Dokja supported the staggering Han Sooyoung. She almost knocked his hand away, but sighed instead and said,
“Never make me do anything like this again.”
“You were the only one who could do it.”
Hearing those words, Han Sooyoung bit her lip hard.
“You know what readers want.”
「What ‘ending’ did Kim Dokja want?」
In that desperate situation, with every world against her, that was the question Han Sooyoung had considered.
And perhaps she had now reached its answer.
“Is this the ending you had in mind?”
“The beginning of that ending.”
Beings ran past them onto the battlefield. Beings who had been ‘Outer Gods’ until a moment ago, but who now had faces and names of their own.
【Everyone, push forward!】
【You fucking constellation bastards!】

Some faces seemed familiar, while others were utterly unknown. Some resembled Kim Namwoon, some Lee Jihye. But they were neither Kim Namwoon nor Lee Jihye. They were simply extras from stories that had ended.
「All those beings were fighting to change this worldline's ending.」
From the zeroth round to the 1863rd. Everyone from the discarded worldlines had gathered here.
【Go! Everyone!】
As she watched them march, Han Sooyoung's heart swelled, too.
All those gathered to resist the prescribed ending were on the side of <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
[Every member of the nebula <Kim Dokja’s Company> has become an ‘Enemy of the Story’!]
Their companions staggered up from behind.
They, too, could finally see Kim Dokja's world.
[The Story, ‘Predictive Plagiarism,’ shares its understanding with every member of <Kim Dokja’s Company>!]
[The Story, ‘Saviour of a Star,’ shares its thoughts with every member of <Kim Dokja’s Company>.]
All the Stories were talking to one another.
Her companions looked around, bewildered. They, too, must have been seeing the horrific masks the Outer Gods had worn fall away.
As Han Sooyoung examined them one by one, she suddenly realized something.
One person still nowhere to be seen.
“Where the hell did that bastard go?”
Come to think of it, it was strange.
The one whose fury toward the constellations burned hotter than anyone's. The one who had fought most fiercely among their companions had been missing from the battlefield for some time.
Then Kim Dokja spoke.
“Over there.”
“What?”
At that, Han Sooyoung hurriedly looked around.
Kwaaaaang!
An explosion erupted ahead, spreading a thick cloud of dust.
The constellations of Asgard were crushing the Outer Gods.
[······Disgusting creatures.]
Every time the constellations swept across the battlefield, dozens of ‘Nameless Ones’ died.
What would once have looked like dying monsters now looked like the deaths of specific human beings.
‘Nameless Ones’ losing arms, legs severed, entrails spilling out.

It was no contest. Most of the ‘Outer Gods’ who had answered Kim Dokja's call were low-grade beings. There had been some high-grade ones, but they had already fallen under the Myth-grade constellations' concentrated fire. With their current forces alone, they could not stop the constellations.
And yet, something was strange.
「Despite that overwhelming difference in strength, they were still holding out.」
Looking closely, she saw something at the very front of the ‘Outer Gods.’
Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsuch!
A dark-blue sword stroke sweeping across the battlefield.
Golden afterimages lingered wherever the blade passed.
[Kuaaaaaak!]
The head of a constellation who had been trampling the ‘Outer Gods’ flew off.
Then a second. Then a third. Amid the shower of Stories bursting forth instead of blood, a black figure swung its sword again and again.
She had already known there was one exceptionally powerful being among the ‘Outer Gods’ fighting at the front.
At first, she had only thought, ‘Of course, it's the final scenario. There would be powerful ones here.’
An ‘Outer God’ swinging a sharp tail, slicing through constellations like sheets of paper.
But it turned out that what it wielded was not a tail, but a pitch-black blade.
[The attribute, ‘Iron Blood Supreme King,’ activates!]
Constellations' corpses lay piled like a mountain. At its peak stood a throne of blood.
The throne's master looked down upon every star in the world.
“Step aside, Yoo Joonghyuk!”
Gritting her teeth, Anna Croft unleashed sword aura.
Anna Croft. America's strongest incarnation, said never to lose a tactical battle.
“I'm the strongest on the continent!”
Then Fei Hu's long spear came thrusting through the air.
Fei Hu. A master of one-on-one combat, and China's strongest incarnation.
“This is our first time fighting directly. But I will win.”
Finally, Ranveer Khan's palm (手掌) moved.
Leaving dazzling shadows like the movement of Kali's hands, his palm poured out more than a hundred waves of energy.
Kwaaaaaaaaah—!
Once again, explosions erupted across the battlefield.
Beyond those explosions, the Stories went on speaking without pause.
[The Story, ‘Life and Death Companions,’ continues its story.]
[Some Stories are being shared through the special effect of ‘Life and Death Companions.’]
[The Story, ‘Hell of Eternity,’ continues its story.]
Amid flashing blades and constellations and Outer Gods falling with their bellies split open, Han Sooyoung recalled an old question people loved to debate.
Who was the world's strongest incarnation?
[Everyone, kill him first! Kill him, and we can break through!]
Now Han Sooyoung could give the answer with certainty.
There was no room for disagreement.
「The world's strongest incarnation was Yoo Joonghyuk.」

Discarding all pride, the constellations rushed him. Even with his shoulder split and his thigh torn, Yoo Joonghyuk held back the surging army of constellations at the very front, his expression unwavering.
It was only possible because he had recovered part of his past memories.
But there was something she could not understand.
[The incarnation Yoo Joonghyuk is currently an ‘Enemy of the Story.’]
“How did that bastard get there first······.”
How had Yoo Joonghyuk joined Kim Dokja before Han Sooyoung or any of their companions?

With the Myth-grade constellations joining in, Yoo Joonghyuk's battlefront was being driven back. As he drew closer, the murky Chaos around him became clearer. The power of Chaos seen in the ‘Outer Gods.’
「Yoo Joonghyuk had once become one with ‘Secretive Plotter.’」
Only then did she understand. The reason Yoo Joonghyuk had been able to take Kim Dokja's side faster than anyone.
Han Sooyoung exploded in anger.
“You sons of bitches, without telling me a thing—”
「Yoo Joonghyuk, too, had known Kim Dokja's intentions.」
Sometimes, deep hatred touched upon deep understanding.
「This tragedy could only work if the characters deceived one another.」
Because he had hated the constellations more than anyone, Yoo Joonghyuk had been able to read Kim Dokja's intentions.
That was why he had acted without hesitation.
「Only that way could they hide from the constellations that this was a ‘story.’」
Pa-tsu-tsu-tsuch!
Having fallen back near them, Yoo Joonghyuk sheathed his sword and spoke.
“I can't hold out much longer.”
His eyes met Han Sooyoung's as he looked back with an impassive face.
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke first.
“You're late.”
“Shut up.”
The three stood side by side.
Yoo Joonghyuk's [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] cried fiercely, and Kim Dokja's black wings spread wide as though to protect them both.
Clenching and unclenching her hand, charged with [Black Flames], Han Sooyoung said,
“······I don't know why it feels like it's been so long.”
Their companions came running up behind them.
“Dokja-ssi! Sooyoung-ssi!”
“Hyung—!”
Lee Hyunsung knelt to protect them with his shield, and Jung Heewon readied her sword beside him.
The Chimera Dragon carrying Shin Yoosung and Lee Gilyoung roared. Yoo Sangah's lotus pedestal spun around them. Lee Jihye's battleship guarded the sky above.
“Load!”
The gun at the edge of the battleship was gathering power.
Gong Pildu, who had built a fortress aboard it, aimed his guns at the ground as though telling them to leave it to him.
[Every star in the nebula <Kim Dokja’s Company> shines brilliantly!]
Shining like a blue sun amid the sparks, Biyoo sweated profusely as she received the coins pouring into <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
Abundant, radiant probability protected them.
Kim Dokja spoke to the companions silently keeping their places beside him.
“Thank you, everyone.”
At those words, every companion's expression wavered slightly.
Jung Heewon bit her lip hard, and Lee Hyunsung wiped his brimming eyes.
Han Sooyoung felt it, too.
「From the beginning, Kim Dokja had never intended to sacrifice himself.」
He had probably thought about it again and again.
A way for everyone to be happy at this world's ending.
He would have known how his companions would be hurt if he sacrificed himself alone.
And read the ruin they would face as the price of fighting together.
That was why Kim Dokja had chosen this scenario.
A scenario that changed the scenario. A scenario that did not follow the prescribed ending. A scenario in which everyone could reach the final curtain together.
Han Sooyoung thought it would be all right for this story to end here.
All the emotion imbued in those words came through vividly. Only now did she feel she understood what Kim Dokja was thinking, what he wanted.
Only now, at the end of everything, had Kim Dokja opened his heart.
「And that was why Han Sooyoung thought this could not be the end.」
“We can talk about that later.”
Jang Hayoung began,
“Everyone, fight without worrying. I won't let anyone die.”
and Lee Seolhwa finished.
“They're coming!”
The constellations' advance was beginning again.
[Their numbers have only increased a little! Don't panic!]
[They're only a minor nebula!]
Amid the scenario's upheaval, a story flowed toward an unknown destination.

Han Sooyoung simply swung her fist. [Black Flames] shot from her palm and pierced the incarnations' heads. Yoo Joonghyuk's [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] met Anna Croft's and Fei Hu's sword strokes, while Jang Hayoung's [Breaking the Sky Force Punch] drove back the constellations pressing in from the side.
[‘Hour of Judgement’ activates!]
Jung Heewon's [Hell Flames Ignition] burned the stars surging in from the front. Lee Hyunsung's steel shield blocked the hidden weapons cutting through the air.
“Everyone, duck!”
Lee Jihye's turtle ship, fully charged, spat fire. In a dazzling explosion, the enemies ahead were swept away.
“Bring that ship down first!”
The incarnations waiting for an opening nearby all flew into the air. Gong Pildu's turrets roared.
“Kuaaaaaak!”
[Pathetic fools!]
Several constellations stepped on the falling incarnations and soared higher. Rising above the turtle ship, they fired their charged magic power at it.
Before the words were finished, the constellation's incarnation body was torn in half.
The Chimera Dragon roared and ripped into the constellation's torso with its enormous maw.
“Hyung! Behind you!”
Lee Gilyoung's locusts blocked the incoming constellations.
The companions advanced little by little. Just as they had through all those years, they made their way, a little at a time, along a path the stars' light could not reach.
Han Sooyoung thought.
In every other star's eyes, they probably looked like monsters trying to destroy the world.
But it didn't matter. If anything, that made it more exciting.
“Kim Dokja! Destroy the Ark!”
Beyond the constellations massed like clouds, she could see the Ark they guarded. Even now, constellations were pouring from its broken bow.
They were all stars who had been sleeping inside the [Ark] in preparation for leaving this worldline.
[The ‘Enemy of the Story’ approaches the Ark.]
[The ‘Enemy of the Story’ will destroy every Story in the world!]
Only by destroying that Ark could they cut off the influx of constellations.
“Hurry!”
[The clash of probabilities causes a radical upheaval in the scenario!]
[<Star Stream> begins revising the conditions of the final scenario.]
But constellations stood before the Ark.
[The constellation, ‘One Responsible for the Cycle of the Universe,’ intervenes on the battlefield!]
[The constellation, ‘Smoking Mirror,’ intervenes in the scenario!]
[The constellation, ‘Master of Thunder and War,’ intervenes in the scenario!]
The Myth-grade constellations who had been watching until now. They had to get past them to reach the Ark.
Individually, they had enough strength. But their total forces fell short.
[The constellation, ‘Spear that Parts the Boundaries of the Sea,’ is enraged!]
Poseidon and Zeus, who had been slaughtering ‘Nameless Ones’ ahead, joined in. Before they knew it, the companions were surrounded in a ring.
Kududududu!
Watching the spear return through a sea of corpses, Yoo Joonghyuk ground out,
“······Poseidon.”
Even <Kim Dokja’s Company> could not take on all of them.
The Great Dokkaebis' expressions were still composed.
It was infuriating. With so much probability, why could they not overcome them?
Han Sooyoung shouted,
“Hey! When are our constellations coming?”
The ones who had promised to come were not here yet.
Uriel, her own sponsor, the Underworld couple, and······.
Kim Dokja asked,
“Do they have to be constellations?”
“What?”
He grinned. That smile Han Sooyoung hated.
“Constellations aren't the only ones who can come to this battlefield now. Thanks to someone, there's enough probability.”

A chill ran down the back of Han Sooyoung's neck. The enormous probability poured into <Kim Dokja’s Company> was draining away at once. Something was coming that could only be called by spending this much probability in one go.
「A being every constellation feared.」
Hellish flames trailing along the ground.
A sun that had burned through eons of Stories was rising in the east.
「‘The Living Flame,’ whose brilliance no star dared rival.」
Opposite the stars screaming as they burned, a blue sea surged forward.
Waves from the west. The ‘Sunken Island’ was rising.
「The calamity of the western world, ‘Master of the Sunken Island.’」
[Kuaaaaaak!]
Swept up in the waves, constellations disintegrated into heaps of Stories in an instant.
Then the northern sky went pitch-black, and constellations fell from it like rain.
「The ruler of the northern universe, ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss.’」
Bursting stars' heads like a wild brat, the ‘king of the Outer Gods’ laughed.
The one who stopped the shock waves they created was a being who had descended upon Lee Hyunsung.
「‘King of the Silver Heart,’ ruler of the southern reaches of space.」
And there was a being approaching from nowhere at all.
With each step, the huge blade of the [Splitting the Sky Sword] scraped the night sky, bringing down stars.
【It has been a long time, Poseidon.】
A man who looked exactly like Yoo Joonghyuk, with a long scar on his face.
‘Secretive Plotter’ calmly approached and gripped Poseidon's throat, smiling.
【This will be the twenty-sixth time I kill you.】
When I finally became an Outer God King, I thought the inevitable had finally arrived.
[You have become the ‘Enemy of the Story.’]
The sensation of the Stories throughout my body shattering. It was not the first time. I had felt it when I was expelled from a scenario and fell into the ‘Story Horizon.’
The difference was that, although I had become an aberrant being, I had not been expelled from the scenario.
[You have become the boss monster of the final scenario.]
[You will be alone forever.]
[No one in this setting will understand you.]
I remember the loneliness I felt then. As though I alone were isolated in this universe. As though I had become a monster who could never understand or be understood.
But that feeling, too, was not unfamiliar.
「“I'm a reporter from the ······ Daily. Do you have a moment?”」
「“That's him. The murderer's son.”」
So I had to take this role.
Because I was the one who could do it best.
Because that was the price of reading the ending of the story called ‘Ways of Survival.’
「【Your companions will not understand your choice.】」
As though he knew my plan, ‘Secretive Plotter’ had said that.
I understood why he had no choice but to say it.
「“We won't know until we try.”」
Neither he nor I was wrong.
The Stories we had built were simply different.
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
A tidal wave of Stories unfolded before me. Dazzling probability sparks spread over it, and above them flowed the constellations' gazes.
[The constellation, ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring,’ watches your Story.]
[The constellation, ‘Father of the Rich Night,’ watches your Story.]
[The constellation, ‘Mass Production Maker,’ watches your Story.]
It was not a gamble I could bring off alone. My becoming an Outer God King had only been the beginning of the final chapter.
Yoo Joonghyuk had fought, my companions had held out, and Han Sooyoung had drawn in the constellations.
And the constellations who believed in us had made their choice.
「And the plan had succeeded.」
‘The Living Flame,’ rising in the east.
The calamity of the western world, ‘Master of the Sunken Island.’
The ruler of the northern universe, ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss.’
‘King of the Silver Heart,’ ruler of the southern reaches of space.
And ‘Great Plotter,’ crawling from nowhere at all.
As the five ‘kings’ gathered, the scenario's volume expanded rapidly. Historical-grade constellations, unable to bear their Status, knelt and vomited Stories.
Kings of calamity who had been excluded from scenarios until now. Freed from the ‘Hounds Pursuing the Abyss’ by abundant probability, they descended directly into the scenario.
‘Secretive Plotter’ was looking at me. I nodded.
「Now it was time for their stage to open.」
[U-uaaah—!]
Several terrified constellations forgot all dignity and began to flee.
Seizing one such constellation by the back of the neck, ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss’—Kim Namwoon of the 999th round—smiled.
【Leaving already would be a problem. We're only just getting started.】
It seemed this flood of probability had restored his strength.
Glancing at me, he muttered,
【And you, don't get the wrong idea. We didn't gather here to help you.】
Then ‘King of the Silver Heart,’ standing beside me, spoke.
【We came to help you.】
“I know.”
As expected, Lee Hyunsung was dependable no matter what round he lived through.
‘Master of the Sunken Island,’ Lee Jihye of the 999th round, moved, too.
Narrative-grade constellations rushing in from both sides tried desperately to stop them, but it was hopeless.
[Th-the island is moving—!]
At the front of the island, covered in green moss, silver gun barrels gleamed.
The largest battleship in the worldline. The complete [Turtle Dragon] spat fire at the world.
Kwaaaaaaah!
As one whole side of the battlefield was swept away in that overwhelming spectacle, I, Han Sooyoung, and even Yoo Joonghyuk could only stare, stunned.
And at the very front, two ‘kings’ were facing the Myth-grade constellations.
「Two people who had fought together long ago were there.」
Uriel of the 999th round, wrapped in a corona of [Hell Flames Ignition]. And Yoo Joonghyuk, who had survived 1,863 infernos to become an ‘Outer God.’
「For a moment, Kim Dokja recalled an old battlefield.」
Yoo Joonghyuk's 999th round.

On the great battlefield of the constellations, Yoo Joonghyuk and Uriel had fought back to back. Yoo Joonghyuk, roaring with both eyes gone, and Uriel protecting him. One of my favorite scenes in all of ‘Ways of Survival.’ That scene was being reenacted before my eyes.
[The Story, ‘Hero and Flame Battlefield,’ awakens from a long sleep!]
A Story that had vanished long ago was connecting the two kings.
【······I'll leave <Olympus> to you.】
Uriel of the 999th round spread her wings first. The moment she released her Status, constellations rushed in as though they had been waiting.
The highest-level constellations of <Papyrus> and <Vedas>. I could also see constellations we had faced in the ‘Demon King Selection.’ Beings like ‘Last Pharaoh’ and ‘Thunder Eating Bird.’
[The Story, ‘Flames of Annihilation,’ begins its story!]

The instant the 999th-round Uriel's sword moved, the first battalion of charging Historical-grade constellations turned to dust and scattered. Pale incarnations turned their backs, and Narrative-grade constellations shrieked,
[Stop that sword! Don't let her swing it!]

And along the path she opened, ‘Secretive Plotter’ moved. With every step, the history of the universe seemed to flow at his feet. He walked neither too slowly nor too quickly, and no one dared stand in his way.
[The Story, ‘Hell of Eternity,’ begins its story.]
The most terrible Story in all worldlines began to speak.
[The Giant Story, ‘Lonely Pilgrim of Destruction,’ begins its story.]
Ruined worlds cried wherever the man's feet fell. The original sin of worlds clung like a shadow and dogged his steps.
「No constellation could stop him, and no Story could save him.」
Enemy or ally, any constellation who loved Stories could not help being bewitched by his tale.
When they suddenly emerged from that sorrow stained with unfathomable wonder and came to their senses, the man already had Poseidon by the throat.
Barely recovering, Poseidon hurriedly shook free of the grasp of ‘Secretive Plotter’ and roared.
[The constellation, ‘Spear that Parts the Boundaries of the Sea,’ rages!]
The Giant Story of <Olympus> was stirring. Wrapped in a terrifying Story, Poseidon's [Triaina] bared savage fangs. It was the might of a Myth-grade constellation, enough to make anyone afraid.
But as another Myth-grade constellation, I saw Poseidon's actions differently.
「Poseidon was afraid.」
His spear, slashing uselessly through the air, was no longer as sharp as before.
At those movements, so unlike an arrogant Myth-grade constellation, Zeus cried out in alarm beside him.
But it was already too late.
Pushushushuk!
Something cut Poseidon's torso, leaving a long black wound across his blue-scaled chest. Giant Stories streamed ceaselessly from it.
[Kuheeeok······!]
Clutching his chest, Poseidon swung [Triaina].
The Spear that Parts the Boundaries of the Sea. Wherever his [Triaina] drew a line became sea.
But not this time. For the first time, the point of his fearless spear wavered, unable to find a target.
「A place his sea could not approach.」
Poseidon's eyes filled with a black abyss.
He was probably seeing the darkest Story in this world now.
A universe where gravity did not reach, where earth, sea, and sky meant nothing. Ruins where everything had been destroyed, leaving nothing precious behind.
The master of those ruins looked up at the stars of <Olympus>.
【You never change, in any worldline.】
It was not a sorrowful voice. If anything, he sounded relieved.
With a soft shing, the blade of the [Splitting the Sky Sword] touched the night sky.
[Shut up—!]
Barely overcoming his fear, Poseidon swung [Triaina] again. And at that very instant, the [Splitting the Sky Sword] moved.
I had once seen Yoo Joonghyuk use a similar technique. A technique devised to cut down stars by a Transcender who had overcome his limits through painstaking effort.
But something was different. This was like—
「Swordsmanship made by one human to face the world.」
Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship (破天劍道).
Transcendent Secret Art (超越奧義).
Universe Slash (銀河斬)
Only now did I truly feel it. The power ‘Secretive Plotter’ had shown in the fierce battle of 「Journey to the West」 had not been all he possessed.
A trajectory more beautiful than any sword stroke I had ever seen.
The world was splitting beneath his single stroke.
Kwadudududu!
Stardust scattered before a slash that split an entire nebula. And at the end of that magical ray stood Poseidon. With a crunch, his arms and legs were severed at once.
[Poseidon!]
Zeus cried out in horror.
Stories exploding from ‘Secretive Plotter’ were swallowing the battlefield. The emptiness he had felt while living through the scenarios was expanding.
Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsu-tsuch!

As Poseidon knelt, retching Stories, the Twelve Divine Seats of <Olympus> charged. Ares and Hephaestus roared, swinging sword and hammer. But they, too, were flung back like children before the strokes of the [Splitting the Sky Sword].
Zeus shouted furiously,
[Great Plotter! Do not be arrogant! You have yet to see even a fragment of the myth <Olympus> has achieved!]
Even as he spoke, Zeus was already retreating.
It was obvious. The Ark lay in the direction he was heading.
[Father!]
Abandoned by him, the Divine Seats of <Olympus> were being gnawed at by the ‘Nameless Ones,’ Stories pouring from their bodies.
His face full of resentment, Dionysus vented his fury at his father.
After watching those deities for a moment, I spoke to Han Sooyoung and Yoo Joonghyuk.
“We have to stop Zeus.”
Inside the Ark he was heading for, Giant Stories from countless myths, not just <Olympus>, would be sleeping. Left alone, he would turn this scenario against us again.
We ran with all our strength across the stage covered in the Stories of dead stars and gods.
Han Sooyoung muttered in puzzlement,
“But that bastard······.”
Having cut down Poseidon, ‘Secretive Plotter’ stood blankly, looking up at something. I followed his gaze.
The reason he had not pursued Zeus was simple. His goal had never been merely the annihilation of <Olympus> or the destruction of the Ark.
The focus of his gaze: something hanging far beyond them.
「The Final Wall」.
Endless pages turned in his eyes, as though he were determined to see beyond it this time.
[The probability of <Star Stream> undergoes a radical upheaval!]
The Great Dokkaebis cried out at the unexpected distortion in probability.
[Wait! This is······!]
[Oldest Dream······!]
[The scenario details will be updated due to the upheaval in <Star Stream>!]
[The clear conditions of this scenario vary according to your chosen faction.]
I checked the updated scenario.
<Main Scenario #99 — ■■■>
For the first time, the title of a main scenario had disappeared.
A scenario that had never existed.
A scenario unknown even to the Great Dokkaebis had begun.
Category: Main
Difficulty: ???
Clear conditions: Destroy the Ark and stop the Great Dokkaebis' plan.
I heard the Great Dokkaebis' shocked voices. Now they, too, would pay the price of giving up being ‘storytellers’ to become characters in this world.
The scene around us was changing as well. As though the world were accepting us.
Asuka Ren stared at me in shock. Perhaps she, too, could now faintly make out my form.
Amid the sparks, the ‘Outer Gods’ who had inspired fear and loathing were revealing their own forms. They were no longer beings outside the scenario.
[The overwhelming majority of constellations watch your Stories.]
The scenario we had made had been formally born into this world.
[‘Oldest Dream’ is watching your existence.]
‘Secretive Plotter’ was probably hearing this message, too.
More precisely, the message that had appeared before my eyes.
Reward: Final Wall.
“······Hyung, the reward says ‘Final Wall.’”
It was Lee Gilyoung, who had caught up, who raised the question.
But there was nothing I knew for certain, either.
The reward was the [Final Wall]······.
Written like that, it was unclear whether reaching the Final Wall was the reward, or whether we could possess it once the scenario ended.
Was that wall even something anyone could possess?
There was nothing we could know for now.
All that was certain was that finishing this scenario would bring us to the truth of this world.
【Go.】
Under cover from Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round, my companions ran.
‘Secretive Plotter’ and the other Outer Gods held back the constellations pursuing us.
The Ark was before our eyes now. If we could just destroy it, we would reach the end of all these scenarios.
[Stop them—!]
Once again, starlight poured from the night sky. It was astonishing that there had been so many stars. Constellations who had been hiding who knew where.
[It's the Outer God King! Get him!]
Constellations charging with their weapons aimed at me. They had lived as lackeys of great nebulae and gained entry to the ‘final scenario’ without even properly clearing scenarios.

Surprisingly, some of them had once subscribed to my channel, or were still subscribing. Those who had occasionally sponsored me and egged me on. Those who had wanted the intense catharsis of a satisfying payoff and urged me toward sensational developments.
Now they stood on the opposite side.
[Kill them!]
Some of my companions also seemed shocked to see them turn against us.
